info.name: Atlassian Admin Account Issue Custom Field Options API

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the custom field option.

items.docs:
Returns a custom field option. For example, an option in a select list.

Note that this operation **only works for issue field select list options created in Jira or using operations from the [Issue custom field options](#api-group-Issue-custom-field-options) resource**, it cannot be used with issue field select list options created by Connect apps.

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

info.name: Atlassian Get Custom Field Options Context

params.name: fieldId
params.description: The ID of the custom field.

params.name: startAt
params.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

items.docs:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of all custom field option for a context. Options are returned first then cascading options, in the order they display in Jira.

This operation works for custom field options created in Jira or the operations from this resource. **To work with issue field select list options created for Connect apps use the [Issue custom field options (apps)](#api-group-issue-custom-field-options--apps-) operations.**

info.name: Atlassian Create Custom Field Options Context

params.name: fieldId
params.description: The ID of the custom field.

items.docs:
Creates options and, where the custom select field is of the type Select List (cascading), cascading options for a custom select field. The options are added to a context of the field.

The maximum number of options that can be created per request is 1000 and each field can have a maximum of 10000 options.

info.name: Atlassian Update Custom Field Options Context

params.name: fieldId
params.description: The ID of the custom field.

items.docs:
Updates the options of a custom field.

If any of the options are not found, no options are updated. Options where the values in the request match the current values aren't updated and aren't reported in the response.

Note that this operation **only works for issue field select list options created in Jira or using operations from the [Issue custom field options](#api-group-Issue-custom-field-options) resource**, it cannot be used with issue field select list options created by Conn

info.name: Atlassian Reorder Custom Field Options Context

params.name: fieldId
params.description: The ID of the custom field.

items.docs:
Changes the order of custom field options or cascading options in a context.

This operation works for custom field options created in Jira or the operations from this resource. **To work with issue field select list options created for Connect apps use the [Issue custom field options (apps)](#api-group-issue-custom-field-options--apps-) operations.**

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

info.name: Atlassian Delete Custom Field Options Context

params.name: fieldId
params.description: The ID of the custom field.

params.name: contextId
params.description: The ID of the context from which an option should be deleted.

params.name: optionId
params.description: The ID of the option to delete.

items.docs:
Deletes a custom field option.

Options with cascading options cannot be deleted without deleting the cascading options first.

This operation works for custom field options created in Jira or the operations from this resource. **To work with issue field select list options created for Connect apps use the [Issue custom field options (apps)](#api-group-issue-custom-field-options--apps-) operations.**
